text:
anna: saw dashboard p95 regressions after prefetch flip, looks like authz calls multiplied per tile. anyone seeing this?
jordan: confirmed on canary traces, prefetch fans out N subqueries each hitting authz. spike in QPS.
samir: logs show identical checks repeated (same actor + resource). N+1 problem.
maria: we moved authz to renderer for locality; missed dedupe. suggestion: short-lived gateway decision cache to dedupe during a single page load.
claire: staleness risk on revokes. need invalidation strategy.
tim: propose TTL=5s + event-driven invalidation on policy revision; store revision with entry.
ryan: memory concern at scale -> bounded LRU per-tenant shards, hashed keys, store only allow/deny+expiry+rev.
security: 5s okay for most cases; require forced invalidation API and audit for urgent revokes.
deploy-bot: perf canary: upstream authz QPS down from 12k to ~3.8k with proto cache (hit ~68%), dashboard median load improved ~25%.
